mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ont_value_index (instance_key, version, path, status, value_text, topics) VALUES
(#{row.instanceKey}, #{row.version}, #{row.path}, #{row.status}, #{row.valueText}, #{row.topics,typeHandler=com.tioka.ontology.infrastructure.PgTextArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[])
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ont_value_index WHERE instance_key = #{instanceKey} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT instance_key, version, path, status, value_text, topics FROM ont_value_index WHERE instance_key = #{instanceKey} AND version = #{version} ORDER BY path
